title: Wow! A Big Letter D! 🦖 D Is for Dinosaur & Dog | Learn ABC with Baby Jimmy | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A big orange letter D pops out of the toy box right beside Baby Jimmy! 🦖 Sing along with Jimmy and learn the letter D, its sound "duh, duh, duh" and two D words: dinosaur and dog.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A big letter D!" – D, D, D! Duh, duh, duh!
🦖 D is for dinosaur! Stomp, stomp, stomp! Stomp your feet with Jimmy!
🐶 D is for dog! Woof, woof, woof! Wiggle, wiggle with me!
🤔 "Dinosaur, dog... what letter?" – can you say it? D! Yay!
👋 D says duh, duh, duh! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: the letter D • the D sound "duh" • dinosaur • dog • stomp and wiggle along

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun ABC phonics song for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Jimmy finds a big letter D in his room, sings its sound, stomps like his green dinosaur, wiggles with his toy puppy and asks you which letter dinosaur and dog start with. After watching, can you say "D says duh, duh, duh" with Jimmy?
